review.method: Contractor agent viewed all ten source-bound 960x803 RGB sheets before detector/flow outputs; corrected tight visible extents. Independent Reviewer viewed all ten and native ambiguous crops, challenged shadow-person and horizon-vehicle assignments. No human review.
review.scope: Fixed selected candidates only, not exhaustive scene objects. Published radial labels unchanged. Clipped but identifiable Mercedes retained in primary; clipping remains unknown in secondary extent test.
